reviewLevel: assistant engineering review at native resolution; not human or expert verified; no consent or expert approval claimed
rights: publisher declaration only (as recorded per photo in manifest-v4); no individual consent record

selection.rule:
Acne v6 limited TRAIN extension: choose at most 100 more v4-TRAIN positive photos for assistant engineering review.

Pool = manifest-v4 photos with kind positive-photo and role TRAIN (v3 role TRAIN only, acne cohort; never the 941 UNKNOWN cohort),
minus the 65-photo v5 core, minus every photo (and research group) of the failed product evaluations (Scope B, controls, held-out 20,
reviewed negatives), minus every RESERVED_V2_EVAL / TEST / VALIDATION group. Product suitability is decided ONLY from pixels and the
product contract (decode limits, MediaPipe, replayed gates with eyewear UNKNOWN, product tile budget) - no model output is read.
Selection is deterministic and model-free: round-robin over (source archive, face-brightness tercile) strata; inside a stratum photos
with explicit confounder boxes (mole/freckle/pigmentation/pores/dark spot) and small source boxes come first, then SHA-256 order.

Phases: pool | landmarks | replay | select

boxRules.positive: KEEP only when a clearly visible papule, pustule, whitehead bump or inflamed red spot lies inside the source box at this zoom; IGNORE otherwise (faint/empty/off-target, flat brown or purple post-inflammatory mark, diffuse redness, lip/nose-pore/eye-area, beard/hair, glare, blur/low light, or uniform bumpy skin texture where the boxed bump is not distinct from its surroundings). Source boxes are unchanged in the source records.
boxRules.confounder: KEEP as explicit known negative only when the box tightly holds a non-acne mark (brown mole, flat pigment spot, pores) and no possible acne lesion; IGNORE large region boxes (they may contain lesions), reddish or ambiguous spots and low-resolution boxes.

roi.rule: ACCEPT only when the whole region inside the contour shows clearly clean, measurable visible skin; REJECT (stays UNKNOWN) on any spot, redness, raised texture or possible whitehead/milia texture, pigment or dark mark, hair/beard, shadow, glare, blur/low light, background, or thin fragments/edge strips

missingCandidates: not annotated: no new lesion boxes were drawn (engineering ROI rejections record suspected unlabeled spots only at region level)
